clusters.headline: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
clusters.summary: The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

clusters.headline: South Africa: This South African River Has a Bacteria Count Off the Charts - a Natural Filter Is Cleaning It for Watering Food Gardens
clusters.summary: [The Conversation Africa] Every day, millions of litres of polluted water flow through many South African rivers and disappear into the sea.

clusters.headline: Cameroon/Malawi: Wafcon 2026 - Chawinga Sisters Fire Malawi Into Historic Final As Cameroon End Morocco's Dream
clusters.summary: [Premium Times] With Malawi and Cameroon now set for the final, the 2026 WAFCON has produced a fascinating title clash between a debutant nation chasing its first continental crown and a former powerhouse seeking to reclaim its place at the top of African women's football

clusters.headline: Africa: Africans Migrate for Jobs Mostly Within the Continent - Why Regional Skills Partnerships Are Needed
clusters.summary: [The Conversation Africa] In 2024, 25.1 million Africans were living in other countries on the continent. Labour migration has long been a defining feature of Africa's economic landscape.

clusters.headline: Social media trends to blame? Why Malaysia is tightening hiking rules and what it means for hikers
clusters.summary: Malaysia is tightening hiking rules after a rise in search-and-rescue cases, and experts have linked these to people underestimating the risks of mountaineering while pursuing aesthetic content for social media.

clusters.headline: Africa: Mounting Fatalities Linked to Militant Islamist Violence in Africa Amid Shifting Tactics
clusters.summary: [ACSS] Fatalities linked to militant Islamist violence in Africa surpassed 20,000 deaths for the fourth consecutive year, underscoring the resiliency of militant groups across the Sahel, Somalia, the Lake Chad Basin, and Mozambique.

clusters.headline: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
clusters.summary: Some see them as sinister or hunt them for ritual use but these birds play a vital role in nature's cycle.

clusters.headline: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift - 'Best night of my life'
clusters.summary: In the comments, Kelce called Swift his "wife" for first time and said it was a "childhood dream" to wed at Madison Square Garden.

clusters.headline: Central African Republic: French Ambassador to CAR Disciplined Over Misconduct Allegations
clusters.summary: [RFI] France's foreign ministry has launched disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to the Central African Republic, following allegations that he repeatedly brought young women to the official residence in Bangui and had sexual relations with some of them.

clusters.headline: Greetings from a surreal expanse of sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil
clusters.summary: The pristine white sand dunes of the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park are bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other. Thousands of lagoons fill up after the rainy season.
